file.description: Absolute path to the generated animation

primary.name: mcode-tools
primary.notes: Cloud-hosted motion-graphics / animation via mcode-tools CLI with the MiniMax-H3 model (recommended for quality). Async submit + poll pattern (max wait 600s, poll every 10s). H3 renders a synchronized native audio track as part of the video, so no separate TTS step is needed.

fallbacks.name: local-ffmpeg-color
fallbacks.notes: 1-second ffmpeg color frame. Color is style-dependent (logo -> navy, infographic -> teal, kinetic -> crimson) so the operator can spot the fallback in the rendered file.

fallbacks.name: local-placeholder-text
fallbacks.notes: Plain-text file (last-ditch) when ffmpeg is not on PATH either.
